  hc.latitude::float AS latitude, 
  hc.longitude::float AS longitude,
  hc.address
FROM 
  healthcentres hc
WHERE 
  hc.name ILIKE '%BISMILLAH%'
  AND hc.latitude IS NOT NULL;

  cd.customer_id,
  c.name,
  c.latitude,
  c.longitude
FROM 
  customer_details cd
  JOIN customers c ON cd.customer_id = c.id
WHERE 
  c.name ILIKE '%Bismillah%';
